offering_description.value: Designs and markets lifestyle apparel, accessories, and home goods for consumers and retail accounts. It sources products from third-party manufacturers and sells through its own stores and websites, wholesale accounts, and licensing partners. It also operates restaurants and bars.

primary_products.value: casual and resort apparel; swimwear; footwear; fashion accessories; home furnishings

customer_segment.value: B2C: Shoppers buying casual and resort wear for adults and children, and restaurant and bar guests; B2B: Department stores, specialty retailers, and companies that license its brands

end_markets.value: apparel and accessories; home furnishings; restaurants and bars

revenue_model.value: product sales: Apparel, accessories, and home goods sold directly to shoppers and through wholesale accounts; service fees: Meals and drinks purchased at company-operated restaurants and bars; licensing or royalties: Brand rights for third-party products such as home furnishings
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Designs lifestyle goods, sources them from contract manufacturers, and sells to consumers and retail accounts; retailer: Sells its branded goods to shoppers through company stores and websites; service provider: Prepares and serves meals and drinks to guests at company-operated restaurants and bars

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with a presence in Canada and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: Resort and casual apparel, swimwear, accessories, home goods, and restaurants tied to a lifestyle brand

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated boutiques, outlet stores, restaurants, and bars; online: Brand-operated e-commerce sites; third-party retail: Department stores and independent specialty shops; partners / resellers: Licensees that make and distribute branded goods such as home furnishings
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; third-party retail; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Apparel labeling and import rules, plus local food safety and liquor licensing requirements for restaurants and bars.

notes: The current extent of its operations outside the United States is uncertain.
